name: @velaros-ai/text-files
description: Lossless text files on disk for capability spaces: encoding detection (UTF-8, UTF-16 with or without BOM, GB18030), strict decoding, encoding back to the original bytes, atomic replacement that keeps permissions and links, and bounded or streaming reads.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test/text-codec.test.ts test/text-file-io.test.ts
